originalObservations: Small cobalt/cyan fish with broad oval body, straight triangular tail paddle, thin pointed side fins and dorsal strip.
Paired white eye mounds and navy pupils read clearly from S. Body/fins are sparse angular planes and the front underside falls dark.
targetObservations: Recognizable blue generic fish, fuller pear-like head/body, broad rounded forked tail and fleshy side fins, strong blue/cyan turning planes.
Friendly large white eyes with layered dark blue pupils and clear glints, a small recessed rounded mouth, central dorsal ridge and broad soft highlight bands.
Target occupies much more of its canvas than the original; its registration and scale are aesthetic drift, not a hard contract.
Fine sweeping body bands and blue edge fringe are not a mandate to paint/repair pixels or introduce glitter.
styleObservations: Plant reference uses saturated local colors, broad readable turning planes, rounded crafted edges and soft warm material highlights with local contact shade.
Apply its warmth and volumetric clarity without converting the blue fish palette to green/orange, adding directionally biased illumination, or treating a glossy target as exact photometric law.
nativeObservations: Source is an animated volumetric actor; identity and functional sockets/rig matter. Exact original topology, weak thin wedges, old part count and sparse detail are not aesthetic locks.
